# Songbench

> A free, browser-local audio version studio. One file in, several versions out. No signup, no upload, no watermark.

## What it does

- Slow down or speed up 50-125 percent while keeping the original pitch (Web Audio preservesPitch)
- Transpose -12 to +12 semitones, applied on export
- A-B loop any section by dragging on the waveform
- Remove center-panned lead vocals with L-R cancellation
- Generated convolution reverb (hall / room / plate style impulse responses), warm bass EQ and 8D stereo pan
- Eight one-click presets: original, slowed + reverb, nightcore, daycore, sped up, backing track, practice 70%, 8D
- Batch export several versions of one file as 16-bit WAV, plus a plain-text manifest (Pro)
- Share a practice sheet by URL hash: speed, key, loop points, tempo and notes. No audio travels with the link.
- Automatic tempo (BPM) and key estimates computed locally with an energy-envelope autocorrelation and a chroma FFT; both are estimates the user can override (one free analysis, unlimited with Pro)
- Beat grid overlay and beat-snapped A-B loops; suggested eight-bar sections
- Practice library: save and reopen named setups with student labels and notes (one setup free, unlimited with Pro)
- Speed ladder ZIP: graded tempo versions from one file, plus a manifest and practice sheet (Pro)
- Multi-file batch ZIP: apply the current settings to a queue of audio files in one download (Pro)
- Six UI languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian, Japanese, Russian

## Architecture

Every entry page is the same single-page application. There is no audio upload endpoint and no
analytics. Audio is decoded with decodeAudioData, processed with OfflineAudioContext and
encoded to WAV inside the browser. Server functions are limited to payments and identity:
/api/checkout creates a Waffo hosted checkout session, /api/webhook verifies signed payment
events, /api/auth/* verifies Google ID tokens, and /api/entitlement checks that a completed,
non-refunded Waffo order belongs to the signed-in account. They never receive audio.

Google sign-in is deliberately lazy: the free preview needs no account, loads no Google script,
sets no cookie and makes no auth request. Buying Pro or using a Pro feature triggers sign-in;
checkout is refused without a verified Google ID token, and Pro is unlocked only after the server
confirms a matching Waffo order. The entitlement is a signed HttpOnly cookie re-checked daily,
with no KV and no licence database. The Client ID is public; no Client Secret is used or stored.

Free tier: playback, all effects and presets, one automatic analysis, one saved practice setup
and a 60-second WAV preview. Pro ($19 once): full-length exports, unlimited detection, unlimited
saved setups, printable homework sheets, Speed Trainer and ZIP practice packs. Pro is a convenience
unlock rather than DRM - all processing is local, so the page script could be modified.
Saved practice setups live only in browser localStorage (key songbench.library.v1). No audio is ever stored or uploaded, no cookie is set for the library, and there is no server-side copy. Users can export a JSON backup and import it on another device. Tempo and key detection, ZIP assembly and printing all run locally. No openapi.json is published; the capability list is /capabilities.json.

## Rights and scope

Songbench does not host a song catalogue, does not supply lyrics and does not fetch audio from video
platforms. The user supplies the audio and the rights. Slowing or adding reverb to a copyrighted
recording does not make it royalty-free. Share links contain practice parameters only.

## Note on draft pages

Only publish=yes pages are deployed. Rows marked verify or hold stay in pages.csv as a
translation and feature backlog; they are not served on this domain and are absent from
the sitemap. /privacy/ and /about/ are static pages with no application code.


## Contact

Public contact address: contact@songbench.online (a domain mailbox that forwards to the operator). Used for billing invoices, payment questions, licence restoration and bug reports. The studio itself collects no email; a message is only created when a visitor writes to it.

## Remix maker

Slowed + reverb, Nightcore, Daycore and Sped up are one-click presets that let pitch follow the speed (the classic tape-style remix sound). Switch Pitch to locked for practice work in the original key.
